g.title: cmake_state
g.text: mulle-container — state this cmake config changes outside itself
every write that outlives the file making it · search paths, flags, cache keys, the link+compile contract, the install tree

g.title: cluster_state_global
g.text: visible to every target configured after this point, in this directory and everything below it

g.title: cluster_state_cache
g.text: persisted between reconfigures, shows up in ccmake, and is inherited by a project that embeds this one

g.title: cluster_state_export
g.text: what a target that links this library compiles and links against - the public contract, also what gets installed

g.title: cluster_state_install
g.text: the files and the cmake package written into the install tree

g.title: __legend__
g.text: left column: the file doing the writing, in execution order
right column: the piece of state it writes to
a write is shown only if it outlives the file that makes it
PRIVATE target flags are hidden unless --show-private
read-only commands (find_*, execute_process) are not state
dashed edge: issued from inside a function()/macro()
